Is it really free?
Yes. Every game on the site is free to play, and there is nothing to buy. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account, no sign-up and no newsletter. You open a game and play.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. The games run instantly in your browser, with no downloads and no installs.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, many games are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category. Games built for a wide screen ask you to turn the phone sideways, and a few older games need a keyboard and mouse and say so on their page.
Is it safe for my kids?
The site only allows family-friendly games, with no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Recently played games, favourites and your light or dark choice are kept in your own browser and never leave your device. Most games also save their progress the same way, so clearing your browser data or using private mode will erase it.
A game will not load. What can I do?
If it does not start, tell us which game it was by emailing contact@ilovewebgames.com so we can look into it. Please include the game's name.
Where do the games come from?

Six games are made by Door 404, our own studio in Novi Sad, Serbia. The rest are licensed from the networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, plus 16 games sent in directly by independent developers. We never copy games from other portals.
I made a game. Can I submit it?
Yes, it is free and non-exclusive at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. A real person plays every submission, and accepted games get their own page that credits you and links back to you.
How do I get my game removed?
Email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will take it down. Your game stays hosted on your own server, and you can ask for removal at any time.
Can I embed a game on my own website?

You can embed the games made by Door 404: each has an "Embed this game" box with ready-made code on its page. Games from other developers are not ours to licence, so we cannot offer them for embedding.
How do I reach a real person?
Write to contact@ilovewebgames.com. The site is run by Door 404, an escape room and game studio from Novi Sad, Serbia.
